label.zh: 预期加溢价，两项分不开

reason.zh: 第 3 章用预期假说加期限溢价搭曲线，并说明同一条曲线有两个未知数、只有一个方程，必须再加假设才能拆开。
reason.en: Chapter 3 builds the curve from the expectations hypothesis plus a term premium and shows one curve gives two unknowns and one equation, so splitting it needs extra assumptions.

label.en: The forward rate is the break-even line

reason.zh: 第 4 章：曲线若正好按今天的远期利率变化，持有一年的回报恰好等于 1 年期利率；远期利率就是让长短两种做法打平的那条线。
reason.en: Chapter 4: if the curve moves exactly to today’s forwards, a one-year hold earns exactly the one-year rate; the forward is the line that makes long and short strategies break even.

label.zh: 超额回报就是期限溢价
label.en: Excess return is the term premium

reason.zh: 第 4 章拿持有期的超额回报去检验第 3 章那条式子里的期限溢价：样本平均为正，但只有约 1.4 个标准误。
reason.en: Chapter 4 tests chapter 3’s term premium with realised excess holding returns: the sample mean is positive but only about 1.4 standard errors from zero.

label.en: Sixty-four years is a small sample

reason.zh: 第 4 章说平均超额回报离零只有约 1.4 个标准误，样本太小不能单凭它断定期限溢价为正，并链到《数字没有说谎》的小样本一章。
reason.en: Chapter 4 notes the mean excess return is only about 1.4 standard errors from zero, too small a sample to prove a positive premium, and links the small-sample chapter of numbers-lie.

label.zh: 看不见的溢价，两种估法

reason.zh: 第 5 章把《央行调一个利率》第 4 章的期限溢价落到两个官方模型（ACM 与 Kim–Wright）的估计上，并说明二者为什么会不同。
reason.en: Chapter 5 turns the term premium of why-one-rate chapter 4 into the estimates of two official models, ACM and Kim–Wright, and explains why they differ.

label.zh: 同样的久期，不同的凸性

reason.zh: 第 7 章先用三句话回顾久期与凸性（链到《央行调一个利率》第 2 章），再用它们对冲一笔负债、比较哑铃型和子弹型组合。
reason.en: Chapter 7 recaps duration and convexity in three sentences (linking why-one-rate chapter 2), then uses them to hedge a liability and compare barbell and bullet portfolios.

reason.zh: 第 8 章对 ACM 的 1–10 年零息利率的月度变动做主成分分析，得到水平、斜率、曲率三个形状。
reason.en: Chapter 8 runs a principal-component analysis on monthly changes of the ACM 1–10-year zero rates and finds level, slope and curvature.

reason.zh: 第 8 章：三种形状就是利率变动协方差矩阵的特征向量，并链到特征值与特征向量一课。
reason.en: Chapter 8: the three shapes are eigenvectors of the covariance matrix of rate changes; it links the eigenvectors lesson.

label.en: The barbell loses on a twist

reason.zh: 第 8 章指出，上一章让哑铃吃亏的扭转就是第二种动法（斜率）；久期只管第一种（水平）。
reason.en: Chapter 8 points out that the twist which hurt the barbell in chapter 7 is the second shape (slope); duration covers only the first (level).

reason.zh: 第 9 章把倒挂与衰退的完整记录留给《央行调一个利率》第 4 章，自己补的是倒挂里预期和期限溢价各占多少。
reason.en: Chapter 9 leaves the full inversion-and-recession record to why-one-rate chapter 4 and adds how much of an inversion is expectations and how much term premium.

reason.zh: 第 9 章回到第 3 章的搭建器：按“降息在路上”曲线就倒挂；期限溢价很低时，不预期大幅降息也会倒挂。
reason.en: Chapter 9 returns to chapter 3’s builder: a path of cuts inverts the curve, and so does a very low term premium without big cuts expected.

reason.zh: 第 9 章用第 5 章的 ACM 模型把倒挂拆成预期和溢价两部分，并注明换成 Kim–Wright 比例会不同。
reason.en: Chapter 9 uses chapter 5’s ACM model to split an inversion into expectations and premium, noting the shares change under Kim–Wright.

label.en: What a recession is, and who dates it

reason.zh: 第 9 章问倒挂是否预示衰退，先链到《经济是怎样被计量的》第 7 章说明衰退的定义和认定。
reason.en: Chapter 9 asks whether inversions predict recessions and first links how-an-economy-is-measured chapter 7 for what a recession is and who dates it.

reason.zh: 第 9 章：衰退样本只有八次左右，只看命中、不看虚警就是忽视基础比率，并链到《数字没有说谎》那一章。
reason.en: Chapter 9: with about eight recessions, counting hits but not false alarms is base-rate neglect; it links that chapter of numbers-lie.

label.zh: 利差是相对国债曲线的
label.en: A spread is over the Treasury curve

reason.zh: 第 10 章把有违约风险的现金流折现、倒推出收益率，再减去同期限的无风险（国债）利率，得到信用利差。
reason.en: Chapter 10 discounts the risky cash flows, backs out a yield and subtracts the same-maturity risk-free (Treasury) rate to get the credit spread.

label.zh: 预期损失 = 概率 × 损失

reason.zh: 第 10 章：利差最粗略地等于“每年违约的概率 × 违约时损失的比例”，即一年的预期损失。
reason.en: Chapter 10: roughly, the spread equals the annual default probability times the loss given default, a year’s expected loss.

label.zh: 利差为什么比预期损失大

reason.zh: 第 10 章把利差超过预期损失的部分部分归于违约扎堆发生在经济最差的时候，第 11 章用相关违约模型展开。
reason.en: Chapter 10 attributes part of the spread above expected loss to defaults clustering in the worst times; chapter 11 develops this with a correlated-default model.

reason.zh: 第 11 章：评级会迁移，评级机构的迁移矩阵就是一个马尔可夫链的转移矩阵，并链到马尔可夫链一课。
reason.en: Chapter 11: ratings migrate, and an agency’s migration matrix is a Markov-chain transition matrix; it links the Markov chains lesson.

reason.zh: 第 8 章的形状词在第 12 章有了数字：2024 年 9 月降息后曲线一边牛市变陡（短端降），一边熊市变陡（长端涨）。
reason.en: Chapter 8’s shape words get numbers in chapter 12: after the September 2024 cut the curve bull-steepened at the short end and bear-steepened at the long end.

reason.zh: 第 12 章记下美联储 2025 年 12 月 1 日起停止缩表、改买短期国库券，并链到《央行调一个利率》第 10 章的 QE 与 QT。
reason.en: Chapter 12 records the Fed ending balance-sheet runoff from 1 December 2025 and buying bills, linking why-one-rate chapter 10 on QE and QT.

reason.zh: 第 12 章用名义 = 实际 + 盈亏平衡通胀拆 2024–2026 年 10 年期收益率的上升；TIPS 本金按 CPI 调整，并链到 CPI 的编制。
reason.en: Chapter 12 splits the 2024–2026 rise in the 10-year yield as nominal = real + breakeven; TIPS principal follows CPI, and it links how CPI is built.

label.zh: 也许是 r* 变高了

reason.zh: 第 12 章的常见解释之一：长端上升也可能是市场认为中性利率 r* 比模型假设的高，链到《央行调一个利率》第 6 章。
reason.en: One of chapter 12’s common explanations: the long end may have risen because markets see a higher neutral rate r* than the models assume; it links why-one-rate chapter 6.
